note: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Every parameter below is a synthetic placeholder chosen to make the prototype run. None is calibrated to real UK insurance claims; results are not forecasts.

repair._why: Lognormal around the repair estimate: median = estimate x median_to_estimate, log-sd sigma. Synthetic.

common_shock._why: One latent collision-severity factor Z ~ N(0,1) links repair costs (Gaussian loading) and injury probability (logit shift). Synthetic strength.

injury._why: Two-stage frequency-severity: P(any third-party injury claim) by collision severity, then a tiered lognormal severity. Synthetic.

third_party_property._why: Other third-party property (walls, street furniture) when not reported. Synthetic.

legal_and_handling._why: Fixed handling cost plus legal cost as a lognormal share of property and injury payments. Synthetic.

recovery._why: Bernoulli success, then a Beta-distributed fraction of the recoverable amount. Synthetic.
